# Instructions for accurately documenting failed brake tests in a vehicle inspection report

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
3. Note the location of the brake-related incident.
4. Select the vehicle type and model.
5. Note the date of the brake-related incident.
6. Record all damaged or affected components.
7. Give the proper assessment of the brake-related incident: Estimate the necessary amount of work, and include an indication of whether the vehicle can be repaired or replaced.
8. Talk with the person who owned or operated the vehicle before the incident took place.
9. Discuss with them the cause of the brake-related incident, and if necessary, work with the service provider to restore the vehicle to a safe operating state.

10. Take photos of the damaged area, and the surrounding environment for use in a report.
11. Insert the photos into the appropriate section of the inspection report.
